typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Status as string,
		ClaimId as string,
		ExpiryDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ClaimKey as integer,
		StatusReason as string,
		ReviewIteration as string,
		LOB as string,
		ReviewType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		ClaimId = {Claim ID},
		ExpiryDate = {EXPIRY Date},
		ClaimKey = {Claim Key},
		StatusReason = {Status Reason},
		ReviewIteration = {Review Iteration},
		LOB,
		ReviewType = {Review Type})) ~> OLEDBDestination
